one_line: A cautious yet bold physician–scholar of the Atreya school, whose teachings survive only in a damaged palm-leaf Bhela Saṃhitā.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy build, average height with a calm, grounded posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown complexion, finely trimmed short beard and moustache, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with a focused gaze, faint worry lines at the brow, default expression a composed, observant half-smile as if weighing evidence.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, medium length, neatly pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head; a simple narrow off-white cloth band (like an understated headwrap) circles the head just above the forehead, holding the hair in place.
appearance.costume: He wears a region-neutral but ancient North–South plausible healer’s attire: an unbleached off-white cotton uttariya (upper cloth) wrapped diagonally over the left shoulder and around the torso, modestly covering the chest and back, with a second layer folded over the right side like a short shawl; beneath, a knee-to-ankle-length plain cotton dhoti in muted pale ochre, tied securely at the waist with a visible narrow brown cloth belt; the fabrics are slightly textured, handwoven-looking, with a single thin dark-red border line on both uttariya and dhoti; around his neck hangs a simple wooden-bead mala without ostentation; his wrists bear one plain dark wooden bangle on the right hand; his feet are in simple dark-brown leather-style sandals appropriate to an ancient physician moving between study halls and patients’ homes.
appearance.signature: A bundled palm-leaf manuscript of the Bhela Saṃhitā secured with a dark cord, held in his left hand, with one individual leaf slightly protruding and a slim stylus tucked under the cord to suggest cautious note-taking and fragile textual survival.

ref_desc: Bhela is a medium-brown, lean man in his 40s with almond eyes, short beard, dark hair in a low knot with an off-white headband, wearing an off-white uttariya and pale ochre dhoti with dark-red borders, brown sandals, wooden mala, and holding a bundled palm-leaf manuscript with stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Bhela: a medium-brown complexioned man in his late 30s–40s, lean and calm, with an oval face, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes, a short neat beard and moustache, and dark brown-black hair pulled into a low knot held by a simple off-white cloth band above the forehead. Dress him in an unbleached off-white cotton uttariya wrapped over the left shoulder and around the torso, modestly covering chest and back, with a second fold draped over the right side, and a plain pale ochre ankle-length dhoti tied at the waist with a narrow brown cloth belt; both uttariya and dhoti have a single thin dark-red border line. Add a simple wooden-bead mala at his neck, one dark wooden bangle on his right wrist, and dark-brown sandal-style footwear. In his left hand he firmly holds a bundled palm-leaf manuscript of the Bhela Saṃhitā tied with a dark cord, with one leaf slightly protruding and a slim stylus tucked under the cord. Use off-white, pale ochre, dark brown, dark red, and medium-brown skin tones as the dominant colours, and present him from multiple angles but always with the same face, low-knot hairstyle with headband, modest healer’s garments, and the palm-leaf manuscript and stylus as his constant signature prop.
